snippet.title: Mystery Case Files: Fate's Carnival  --  OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
In this tenth installment of Big Fish's most popular hidden object PC and Mac adventure game, you'll revisit one of Mystery Case Files' most memorable characters, Madame Fate, a gypsy fortune teller. 

Madame Fate has returned from the dead and is in need of your help again, Master Detective. From the moment you set foot on carnival grounds, you realize that something wicked has taken over the eerie circus at Fate's Carnival in Blackpool.

    * Uncover the clues in over 15 hidden object scenes.
    * Take care of Madame Fate's worship-worthy cat, Isis, who will provide help and guidance along the way.
    * Solve over 20 puzzles to receive items you need to continue progressing through the carnival.
    * Collect bobble-heads, cards, and old English pounds which you'll use to decorate Isis's home.
    * The Collector's Edition version comes with fantastic extra features, including an integrated Strategy Guide, downloadable soundtracks, wallpapers, screen-savers, and concept art, as well as bonus game play that contains even more secrets from Fate's Carnival.

Mystery Case Files: Fate's Carnival launches on November 27th, 2013. Available at http://BigFishGames.com!
The iPad version will launch shortly after PC and Mac.

Facebook: http://facebook.com/mysterycasefiles
